name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a PennyLane program with a QNode t
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a PennyLane program with a QNode that applies RX(2.487) and RY(0.671) to one qubit and returns <Z>. Print the result and the analytic value cos(2.487)*cos(0.671). The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
